The meatloaf slice has a textured, browned crust and a lighter, dense interior visible at the cut edge. It is topped with a glossy, dark reddish-brown glaze that pools around the base. A fork rests on the plate behind the meatloaf, partially out of focus. There appear to be some side items or garnishes, possibly mashed potatoes or vegetables, covered in sauce, but they are indistinct.
